product.description: Monoprice™6‑in‑1 USB‑C® Mini‑Dock with HDMI®, Ethernet, plus PD 3.0Versatile USB‑C Docking Solution: 4K HDMI, Gigabit Ethernet, High‑Speed Data Ports & Fast ChargingUnlock the full potential of your workstation with the Monoprice 6‑in‑1 USB‑C Mini‑Dock‑a compact solution that delivers powerful connectivity for today's devices. Engineered for versatility, this sleek hub transforms a single USB‑C port into an array of essential connections. Experience stunning visuals with 4K60Hz HDMI output, enjoy reliable networking through Gigabit Ethernet, and transfer data at blazing speeds using dual USB‑A and USB‑C Gen 2 ports‑up to 10Gbps.Stay productive on the go with rapid charging, thanks to the dedicated USB‑C Power Delivery port supporting up to 100W, ideal for laptops, tablets, and smartphones. Whether you're streaming ultra‑high‑definition video, managing large files, or charging multiple devices simultaneously, the Monoprice Mini‑Dock keeps you seamlessly connected and powered up.Lightweight and travel‑friendly, this mini‑dock fits perfectly into your daily routine or business trips. Robust safety features ensure your devices remain protected.
